title: Bow & Greenery Wall
desc: A lush green-flower wall finished with an oversized white satin bow, dotted with blue larkspur, yellow roses and soft pink accents.

groups.label: Flowers
groups.blurb: Small blue, yellow and pink blooms scattered through the green base.

items.role: Blue delphinium spikes scattered across the wall for the cool blue notes.
Bright yellow roses clustered in small groups through the greenery.
White roses adding soft neutral blooms between the colours.
Pink ball chrysanthemums giving fluffy round pink accents.
Purple star-like sprigs dotted through the middle of the wall.
Yellow mini daisies filling gaps with fine petalled texture.
Small white viburnum-style hydrangea clusters lightening the green mass.

groups.label: Greenery & grasses
groups.blurb: Fine fern-like greens building the wall's base texture.

items.role: Asparagus fern forming the large fine-textured base of the wall.
Long willow-green strands trailing down the wall for hanging lines.
Round-leaf eucalyptus adding small cool-green circles.
Green-yellow speckled leaves dotted through as pattern accents.
Light-green berry sprigs adding tiny round fruit details.
Fine mini asparagus fern filling the remaining green texture.

groups.label: Styling piece
groups.blurb: The statement ribbon finish at the centre of the arch.

items.role: White satin ribbon bow centred on the wall, tails flowing down the sides.
